name: glm-finance
description: Finance plugin bundling two skills: glm-finance (financial data and comprehensive analysis covering quotes, news and earnings) and glm-stock-analysis-skill (individual stock decision dashboards, dividend scoring and watch-list management). Trigger for market data queries, stock analysis and portfolio tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Two finance skills: market data and comprehensive analysis, plus stock decision dashboards and watch-lists.
interface.longDescription: GLM Finance bundles two investment-analysis skills. glm-finance queries market data (quotes, news, earnings) through public endpoints and produces comprehensive analysis; glm-stock-analysis-skill builds individual stock decision dashboards with dividend scoring and watch-list management. Market charts route to the glm-chart plugin's glmcharts skill, and news search routes to the glm-web plugin's skills. Public endpoints, zero API keys; analysis reports land in the user's output directory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-finance plugin skills: <查行情与财务数据 / 个股决策看板 / 股息评分 / 自选股管理>
